# Data Import

```{r}
# Import the dataset
data <- read.csv("health_dataset.csv")

# View the first few rows
head(data)

# Check the variable names
names(data)

# View the table structure
str(data)
```

# Data Cleaning

```{r}
# Clean your selected variables
cleaned_data <- subset(as.data.frame(data), 
              select = c(
                Life_satisfaction, 
                Total_physical_act_time, 
                Work_hours, 
                Smoked, 
                High_BP, 
                Total_active_time, 
                Stress_level, 
                Sense_belonging, 
                Total_income, 
                Gender, 
                Marital_status))

head(cleaned_data)
str(cleaned_data)

```

# Data Description

```{r}
# Summary statistics

#1. Calculate missing values
lapply(cleaned_data, table, useNA = "ifany")

# convert invalid or special missing-value codes to NA before generating missing-value summary

# Life satisfaction: special response codes
cleaned_data$Life_satisfaction[
  cleaned_data$Life_satisfaction %in% c(97, 98, 99)
] <- NA

# Physical activity time: special missing or invalid codes
# Convert values outside the documented valid range to NA
cleaned_data$Total_physical_act_time[
  cleaned_data$Total_physical_act_time < 0 |
  cleaned_data$Total_physical_act_time > 2100
] <- NA

# Work hours: special codes
cleaned_data$Work_hours[
  cleaned_data$Work_hours %in% c(96, 99)
] <- NA

# Smoking: special codes
cleaned_data$Smoked[
  cleaned_data$Smoked %in% c(996, 999)
] <- NA

# High blood pressure: non-response codes
cleaned_data$High_BP[
  cleaned_data$High_BP %in% c(7, 8)
] <- NA

# Total active time: special missing or invalid codes
cleaned_data$Total_active_time[
  cleaned_data$Total_active_time %in% c(99996, 99997, 99998, 99999)
] <- NA

# Stress level: non-response codes
cleaned_data$Stress_level[
  cleaned_data$Stress_level %in% c(7, 8)
] <- NA

# Sense of belonging: non-response codes
cleaned_data$Sense_belonging[
  cleaned_data$Sense_belonging %in% c(7, 8, 9)
] <- NA

# Income: unavailable or non-response code
cleaned_data$Total_income[
  cleaned_data$Total_income %in% c(9)
] <- NA

# Marital status: non-response code
cleaned_data$Marital_status[
  cleaned_data$Marital_status %in% c(3, 9)
] <- NA

#missing_value summary
missing_summary <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(cleaned_data),
  Missing = sapply(cleaned_data, function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
  Missing_Percent = sapply(
    cleaned_data,
    function(x) round(mean(is.na(x)) * 100, 2)
  )
)

missing_summary
```
